output.summary: KEP-600 proposed letting the advanced audit configuration be changed dynamically through an API and objects after cluster provisioning, without restarting kube-apiserver. The KEP was withdrawn on 2021-05-05 after being marked implementable from 2020-12-22.
output.rationale: The motivation was that advanced audit configuration is hard to get right and needs an apiserver restart on each change, which blocks audit add-on tools. The sources do not explain the 2021-05-05 withdrawal itself. The discussion shows the feature stalled over review bandwidth, a policy redesign, and an unclear roadmap, and that sig-auth was still weighing two paths in April 2020.
output.outcome_reason: The sources do not state why the KEP was withdrawn on 2021-05-05. The latest discussion (2020-04-29) says sig-auth was still discussing the feature's future with no changes planned for v1.19. The withdrawal rationale is not recorded in the provided material.

alternatives.why_not: Listed by sig-auth on 2020-04-27 as one of two paths to discuss; the sources do not say which path was chosen or why it was not pursued.

alternatives.option: Dynamic webhook sinks with static policy
alternatives.why_not: Listed by sig-auth on 2020-04-27 as the second path to discuss; the sources do not record a decision on it.

alternatives.option: Original approach: take static audit definitions and expose them through the API
alternatives.why_not: Per pbarker on 2018-12-16, the API review led to rethinking policy handling in favor of a more composable approach (kubernetes/kubernetes PR 71230), so the original approach was revisited.

evidence.quote: We want to allow the advanced auditing features to be dynamically configured. Following in the same vein as Dynamic Admission Control
In the API review https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/67547, we decided it would be a good time to rethink how policy was handled.
I agree this feature needs a roadmap. I would say that at the moment, it's future is unknown.
We're currently discussing the future of this feature in sig-auth, but no changes are planned for v1.19.
